## Soils

Soil survey polygons come from SSURGO, rasterized by map unit key (MUKEY). The MUKEY raster links every cell to its soil map unit properties (e.g., hydrologic soil group, saturated hydraulic conductivity), which drive the curve-number and infiltration inputs to the simulations below.

| SSURGO MUKEY |
| --- |
| [![SSURGO soil map units (MUKEY)](mukey.png)](mukey.png) |

## Simulations

Overland flow is simulated with [`r.sim.water`](https://grass.osgeo.org/grass-stable/manuals/r.sim.water.html), the SIMWE path-sampling solution of the shallow-water flow equations. The default run applies a uniform 50 mm/hr rainfall with no infiltration and Manning's n of 0.1, writing water depth (m) and unit discharge (m^3^/s) every 2 minutes over a 10-minute event. Spatial patterns therefore reflect terrain routing alone; the ground water and sensitivity sections below relax these assumptions.
